notes.title: New version Carpe Lucem 1.2 - now with Steam Workshop support!
notes.notes:
"Carpe Lucem - Seize The Light" version 1.2 is now available

Here are the cool new features:

Improved level editor (Vive Motion Controller required).
Design and exchange your own levels with other gamers through Steam Workshop. We've added two new levels there already. More puzzles under development and scheduled for release in Q4/2016. We can't wait to see the ideas the gamers come up with.

From today we're also offering a demo version via Steam. The free demo allows you to try eight full levels.
